ghost.label: Sell them nothing 👻
ghost.tooltip: Make the watermark area transparent instead of filling it. PNG/WEBP only; enable alpha masking in your LoRA trainer. Air: now a premium feature.

sigma_detect.label: Maximum slop size (%)

detection_prompt.label: Name the branded crap

output_format.label: Takeaway container

detection_skip.label: Attention-span tax
detection_skip.hint: Skip more frames for speed; brief watermarks may be missed. Efficiency has a catch. Shocking.

fade_in.label: Pre-roll buffer
fade_in.hint: Extend removal backward for fading-in watermarks. Not an unskippable sponsor segment.

fade_out.label: Post-roll buffer
fade_out.hint: Extend removal forward for fading-out watermarks. End the brand engagement already.
